description: Steam Deck / controller: the Declare Battle Formations panel must be walkable end-to-end with the D-pad. Reported: 'if I scroll down to the bottom one that's visible and press down, it jumps out of the panel onto the Skip/Confirm buttons' — every STRATEGIC RESERVES row below the fold was unreachable by controller. Root cause: a ScrollContainer CLIPS its overflowing children instead of moving them, so their real global rects run off the bottom of the screen and Godot's GEOMETRIC ui_down search finds the Skip button (98px below the last visible row) before the next checkbox (135px below it). Boots the real MainMenu locked to the pad policy, starts a battle, and drives the dialog on D-pad presses only: ▲ from the button bar enters the panel at its last row, ▼ from the last row ABOVE the reserves section lands on the first reserves row (the exact press that used to escape), a long ▼ run walks every row with the panel scrolling to follow, and only the final row hands off to Skip. Finishes by pressing A on a reserves checkbox so the declaration a Deck player could not previously reach actually lands in the dialog's reserves array.

steps.comment: lock the input mode the way --input-mode=pad / a Steam Deck does, BEFORE the dialog pops — InputDeviceManager only seeds dialog focus while the pad is the active device
GUARD: the whole test is vacuous if the form happens to fit. Assert the panel really does overflow before asserting anything about scrolling past the fold.
without follow_focus the panel never scrolls, so focus would land on rows the player cannot see
THE REGRESSION PIN: no row except the last may answer ▼ with anything other than the next row. Before the fix the last on-screen row answered with the Skip button.
…and the LAST row is the one and only exit to the button bar
InputDeviceManager parks a pad player on the confirm button when the dialog pops
D-pad ▲ from the button bar re-enters the scroll panel
follow_focus dragged the panel to the bottom — the row is focused AND visible
park on the LAST row above STRATEGIC RESERVES — the row the player described being stuck on
D-pad ▼ — the press that used to leap onto Skip
▼ now enters the STRATEGIC RESERVES list instead of escaping to the button bar
the payoff: a unit the D-pad could not previously reach is now declared into Strategic Reserves
back to the top for the full-length walk
30 ▼ presses is more than the row count — a walk that never escapes ends parked on Skip with the panel scrolled to the bottom
the walk really traversed the whole panel — it is scrolled to the very bottom, not stopped at the fold
D-pad ▶ across the button bar: Skip -> Confirm
